agent_presence_prefix.description: Prefix of the agent login lamp's presence id: an agent_login key watches <prefix><user presence_id>. An account's configs/callcenter overrides it

announce_default_interval_s.description: Seconds between periodic announcements when a queue does not set its own

call_publishers.description: How many processes on each node publish what the call actors send, each on an AMQP channel of its own; all of one call's messages go through the same one. Read as the application starts

default_agent_no_answer_status.description: Availability an agent is moved to after too many missed offers, when a queue does not set its own

offer_grace_s.description: Seconds an offer is allowed to run past the agent's ring timeout before it is given up on

queue_refresh_s.description: Seconds between the dispatcher's reads of a queue document from the database instead of the cache, which bounds how long an edit whose change notice was lost stays unseen

reconcile_interval_s.description: Seconds between reconciliation sweeps of agent activity and waiting callers

shards.description: How many dispatcher shards accounts hash into; changing it restarts the application on every node

stub_offer.description: Answer every offer with a process that rings nobody, for a cluster with no media server

stub_offer_answer_ms.description: Milliseconds a stub offer rings before it answers

stub_offer_talk_ms.description: Milliseconds a stub offer stays answered before it ends
